images.filename: Swedish visit to Regional Command North.jpg
images.caption: Commander, ISAF Regional Command North, Major General Markus Kneip, greets Swedish King Carl XVI Gustaf during an unannounced visit to Afghanistan on April 14th. King Gustaf met with country’s forces supporting NATO mission and praised the sacrifice his troops are making during the opening of a new military base 130 kilometers west of Mazar-e Sharif. Photo by TSgt. Bea Schoene.
images.alt: Commander, ISAF Regional Command North, Major General Markus Kneip, greets Swedish King Carl XVI Gustaf during an unannounced visit to Afghanistan on April 14th. King Gustaf met with country’s forces supporting NATO mission and praised the sacrifice his troops are making during the opening of a new military base 130 kilometers west of Mazar-e Sharif. Photo by TSgt. Bea Schoene.

images.caption: Graphic representing the organisational structure of the Bundeswehr's 1st Panzer Division as it appeared in 1989, including training units. Note: "Division Troops", "Replacement Troops", and "Rear Defense Troops" were not commands, I simply added them to streamline and spread out the graphic.
